lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mn3V2Ge crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3 (No. 143), with a unit cell of 24 atoms (Mn18V6Ge3) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis identifies tetrahedral environments for both Ge and V centers, each with four Mn neighbors, while Mn centers show six geometric neighbors (three Ge, three V). The resulting neighbor graph is three-dimensional and spans all 24 sites, and validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Ge and V tetrahedra and between Mn-centered six-vertex polyhedra.
